fields.FIR_Description: During the night of 2025-08-10, around 22:20, a silver motorcycle bearing registration number TN-45-XX-1081 was found missing from the parking space near Kaveri Park Bus Stand Area, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-08-10. Contact details given by the complainant, Rakesh Anand, include the number 9000000340. A person named Nithin Subramani, associated with the number 9000000354, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complaint refers to another person whose identity could not be established. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle reportedly taken from an unattended parking area.
fields.Keywords: motorcycle theft, vehicle, motorcycle, bus stand, night, mobile number, suspect
